serverInfo.name: Bernstein MCP Server
serverInfo.description: The open-source governance layer for AI agents. No model in the coordination loop, so replaying a plan reproduces its task graph byte-identically, and an opt-in HMAC audit chain verifies offline. Create tasks, monitor agents, check status, and track costs via MCP tools. Run locally via stdio transport after pipx install bernstein.

tools.name: bernstein_run
tools.description: Start an orchestration run with a goal, or create a subtask via parent_task_id

tools.name: bernstein_status
tools.description: Get orchestration status: health, tasks and cost

tools.name: bernstein_run_status
tools.description: Poll a run started with bernstein_run

tools.name: bernstein_approve
tools.description: Approve a task that needs human review

tools.name: bernstein_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one task and its subtask tree

tools.name: bernstein_claim
tools.description: Claim a task as a pull worker

tools.name: bernstein_post_message
tools.description: Post a signed message to a task's mailbox

tools.name: bernstein_post_artifact
tools.description: Post an artifact for a task

tools.name: bernstein_task_capsule
tools.description: Fetch the signed context capsule for a task

tools.name: bernstein_shutdown_orchestrator
tools.description: Stop the orchestrator for a project

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Progressively load a role skill pack on demand (backend, qa, security, etc.) - keeps system prompts small

tools.name: bernstein_scenario
tools.description: List, run or check scenarios (tier: all)
